title: Canonical intrinsic compact-support restriction comparison
statement: Let $A,B$ be finite commutative rings in universe $u$, $\varphi:A\to B$ a homomorphism, $X,Z,Y$ schemes in universe $u$, $j:X\to Z$ an open immersion and $r:Z\to Y$ any morphism. Use the ordinary constant-ring module derived categories and geometric operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and the termwise intrinsic open extension $J_{j,A}$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Put $F_A=Rr_{*,A}J_{j,A}$, the reductionCompactSupport presentation [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison]. Define $\rho_{j,r}:F_A\operatorname{Res}_X\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Res}_YF_B$ by first applying the section-normalized open restriction comparison $J_{j,A}\operatorname{Res}_X\cong\operatorname{Res}_ZJ_{j,B}$ and then the inverse of the K-injective-normalized ring-sheaf direct-image restriction comparison [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars]. This is the existing intrinsicCompactSupportRestriction construction. No properness, boundedness or coefficient-composition equation is asserted by this definition.

lean.statement:
def intrinsicCompactSupportRestriction
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] (h : Z ⟶ Y) :
    scalarRestriction φ X ⋙ reductionCompactSupport A j h ≅
      reductionCompactSupport B j h ⋙ scalarRestriction φ Y
